reason: The final model is frozen and graded but has not yet run beside production for a single live slate. Shadow probabilities are logged and graded; the incumbent remains the published authority. Activation is a separate, reviewable decision taken after the shadow has accumulated live evidence.
what_enabling_requires: this file's "state" set to ENABLED in a reviewed commit
the NBA_PROP_SHADOW_PUBLISH environment variable set to the same state
the NBA_PROP_SHADOW_PUBLISH_APPROVAL environment variable set to this file's approval_token
note: A missing switch file reads as DISABLED. The absence of a prohibition is not an approval. Even with all three conditions met, publish_shadow_probabilities still refuses: no shadow publisher has been built, so flipping this switch cannot by itself put a candidate probability on a WizardOfOdds feed.
fallback: Every shadow row carries the incumbent probability in served_probability, in the success branch as well as the failure branch, so the fallback path is the only path anything downstream has ever seen.
